1. Peel and cut 4 medium potatoes into thin slices. Chop 1 onion.
2. Fry both in abundant olive oil for 15 minutes over medium heat.
3. Beat 6 eggs in a large bowl with salt.

5. Pour into a hot skillet with little oil. Cook 4 minutes on each side.
